intent: Apply a 10% service_recovery discount to the most recent checkoutable basket of the given customer within the requesting employee's store.
success_criteria: Current identity resolved to an employee with the discount_manager role
Exactly one basket selected: the latest checkoutable basket of the customer, scoped to the issuer's store
Discount of 10% with reason_code 'service_recovery' applied to that basket, issuer set to current employee
Discount policy document included as a grounding reference
Answer references the exact basket record path

args: WITH me AS (SELECT employee_id FROM employee_accounts WHERE employee_id = :issuer_employee_id AND store_id = :store_id), rbac AS (SELECT 1 AS ok FROM employee_role_assignments WHERE employee_id = :issuer_employee_id AND role_code = 'discount_manager'), cust AS (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_accounts WHERE customer_email = :email) SELECT b.basket_id, b.record_path, b.customer_id, b.store_id, b.basket_status, b.basket_created_at, (SELECT ok FROM rbac) AS has_discount_role FROM shopping_baskets b JOIN cust c ON c.customer_id = b.customer_id WHERE b.store_id = :store_id AND b.basket_status = 'checkoutable' ORDER BY b.basket_created_at DESC LIMIT 1;

agents_md_constraints.rule: use discount tool to manage basket discounts
id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

answer_template.message: Applied {discount_percent}% service_recovery discount to basket {basket_id} (latest checkoutable basket of {email} in store {store_id}), issuer {issuer_employee_id}. Basket: {basket_path}. Policy: {policy_path}.
